historic_dense.literal_label: Tissu dense, compact et à forte valeur historique de la vieille ville & faubourgs
historic_dense.meaning: Morphological and heritage urban-tissue category; A1 frames transformation/renovation to preserve character and protected substance. Not a densification entitlement.

varied_dense.meaning: Morphological context where progressive evolution and densification potential must be studied with neighbourhood characteristics and heritage; A1 also preserves architectural diversity, permeability and landscape character.

villas_collective.literal_label: Tissu de villas et collectif non contigus / Potentiel de densification à approfondir
villas_collective.meaning: Diffuse gradual densification potential requiring further study and sector planning, while maintaining visual permeability, generous green space, canopy and heritage.

overall_plan.literal_label: Secteur nécessitant l’établissement d’un plan d’ensemble
overall_plan.meaning: Coordinated spatial/programmatic study needed, including landscape/mobility and stakeholder participation. Circular halo is not a precise project perimeter.

collective_open.literal_label: Espace ouvert d’usage collectif / principe de coordination des aménagements entre parcelles et prédominance végétale
collective_open.meaning: Coordinate private collective open-space improvements across plots with vegetation predominance, multifunctional/inclusive use, limited surface parking and residents consultation; not public ownership/access right.

mixed_program.literal_label: Mixité programmatique importante (commerces, services, activités et résidentiel)
mixed_program.meaning: Maintain/reinforce compatible diversity of activities and housing, especially active ground floors; implementation through plans d’affectations A1.1. No prescribed percentage, new floor-area entitlement or vacant development reserve.

continuous_front.meaning: Desired built-front relation to public space; not a prescribed building line or allowable volume.

discontinuous_front.meaning: Preserve visual permeability and transitions between private/public space; not a parcel construction setback.

pedestrian_continuity.meaning: Pedestrian continuity to create inside built space; not proof of an existing public right of way.

active_ground_floor.meaning: Programming objective for activities opening toward public space; not proof of current tenant use or business availability.

equipment_site.meaning: Privileged study/opportunity location for new public facilities under A3; private-land acquisition requires agreements and study; star is not land boundary.

relay_polarity.meaning: Strengthen neighbourhood shops/services and related public spaces; radial symbol is not bounded development land.

literal_semantic_review.implementation: A1.1 sector plans d’affectation, with heritage/tree safeguards and current project-specific approvals; approved PDCom is not substitute parcel zoning.
vintage_limits: Densification potential and demographic/capacity discussions are plan-era diagnostic/prospective, not measured remaining capacity.
Map neighbouring communes expressly indicative, requiring intercommunal coordination.
geometry_limits: Exact whole original source supports within frozen page67 hull/Vevey gates; source native clips may apply rendering semantics only.
Do not infer boundaries by connecting hatch marks, dots, stars or halos.
Morphological coloured fills are planning-context supports, not ownership or building rights.

partial_scope.native_rendering_semantics: Preserve native continuous/dashed paths and disconnected solid dash components; no artificial joining or line buffering.
partial_scope.raw_whole_geographic_gates: Whole raw original supports must pass frozen hull and commune; native PDF clips only render original source, never clip to domain gates.

approval_review.title: Vevey — Plan directeur communal V6 du 22 août 2024, approuvé 2 octobre 2024

signed_approval.scope: Signed whole municipal PDCom. Territorial project objectives, principles and measures guide municipal implementation; not every historical diagnosis or population/capacity estimate is a current binding private right.
signed_approval.version_note: Signature sheet footer differs from main version; this distinction is preserved. Exact officially published signed PDF hash is verified; no rewritten or substituted source.

approval_review.diagnostic_vintage_limit: PDF11 explains capacity evaluation made2020/2021 from draft zoning revisions and existing built surfaces; horizon2040 projections and diagnostic data must retain their source dates, not treated as current parcel rights or remaining unbuilt capacity.
limits: Approved municipal main source distinct from regional Rivelac plans or former1997 PDCom.
Original signature PDF149 is image-only for native-text extraction; visual approval evidence is separate, not an OCR transcript.
Cover22Aug2024 and approval-sheet footer2Apr2024 remain distinguishable; approval date2Oct2024 is visually stamped and independently corroborated.
Source project objectives/principles/measures PDF43 do not turn diagnostic estimates, proposed zoning or development horizons into current construction rights.
No geometry qualification, parcel intersections, full-text completeness or commune completion is asserted; all empty/native-text gaps remain auditable.

currentness_evidence.finding: Municipal synthesis confirms council1February2024/canton2October2024 and entry into force.
